decisions.note: Round 2 build only auto-fetches title & favicon (no description or preview image, and no description field to display); client replied 'looks great' without flagging the gap.

Round 3 inline editing deliberately locks the URL as immutable 'identity' and still has no description field, diverging from the spec's url/title/description/tags/note editability; client said 'works for me.'
Round 4 Netscape import preserves title and tags but never mentions preserving original date-added timestamps, contra spec; client approved with 'that all sounds good.'

Round 5 'full-text search' upgrade delivers only AND/prefix/BM25 ranking, with no #tag search syntax, boolean AND/OR/NOT + parenthesised groups, or quoted-phrase exact match; client ended the session satisfied without probing further.
